notes.title: Dungeon Agriculturalization Rogue-like, The Sealed Ampoule has been released!
notes.notes:
Dear Fans,

The Sealed Ampoule has finally been released!
It is currently available at 10% off on release sale.

[previewyoutube=NKPBvn-mLh8;full][/previewyoutube]

"The Sealed Ampoule is a ""Dungeon agriculturalization Rogue-like"" game. As described in the genre name itself, the title features both Rogue-like and farming elements.
Leveling up your dungeon will enable it to produce useful items more efficiently.
Items will help to strengthen your character, thus allowing for exploration and agriculturalization deeper down in the dungeon.

Your main goal is simple: to master dungeon agricultuarization."

The OST has also been released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561690/

Grab the game and OST in a bundle for more savings!

We hope you enjoy this fresh new title!

notes.title: Dungeon "Farming" rogue-like, The Sealed Ampoule joins the Steam Game Festival!
notes.notes:
The Sealed Ampoule is built around the innovative concept of procedurally generated dungeon agriculture.

[h2]Game Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Not only do you cultivate your charcater in this rogue-like but also the dungeon itself, from which you can harvest items and Magic Circles
[*] Investigate the murder that occured in a second hand dungeon!
[*] The game world is based on alchemy and the Cabinet of curiosities (Wunderkammer), and is vibrant as it is mysterious.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=wYyfAKBZJMo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]About the Demo[/h2]
You can play the 1st chapter in this demo (in total there will be 5 chapters).
The types of items and skills you can obtain in this demo are limited to those necessary for chapter 1, plus a little bit extra.
*Please note, you will not be able to transfer any save data to the release version.

[h2]About the Developer[/h2]
Created by CAVYHOUSE, a team of two developers from Kyoto, Japan.

The game is set in the same world as another CAVYHOUSE title, Forget Me Not: My Organic Garden, but ten years before the events of that game.

Forget Me Not: My Organic Garden: https://store.steampowered.com/app/363980/Forget_Me_Not_My_Organic_Garden/

[h3]Developer Comment[/h3]
[quote=author] The Sealed Ampoule is a Dungeon Agriculture Rogue-like game. Generally, rogue-likes have heavy penalties when you game over, but in this game character level and the majority of your items will remain. Also by leveling up your dungeon you can set yourself up better. 

This game takes gameplay features of clicker games (As in sister title Forget Me Not: My Organic Garden) like ""Improve production facilities"" and combines them with dungeon exploration.

We hope you try the demo and experience both the ""Joy of Fighting"" and the ""Joy of Nurturing"". [/quote]
Production is progressing smoothly towards release so if you enjoyed the demop please don't forget to add it to your wishlists!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1396980/The_Sealed_Ampoule/
